notes.title: Hotfix v1.5.1.2
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Thanks everyone for sending reports of bugs or things that needed adjustments, and even suggestions. We've pushed the latest hotfix now which includes the following updates:

[h3]Hotfox v1.5.1.2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player can now move while using the Seeing Tool
[*] Removed FPS cap when vsync is off
[*] Resolved many Null References between loading chapters
[*] Remove Saving while in Chapter Select (Chapter Select does not save your progress, use Continue instead)
[*] Updated several floating models and decals
[*] Fixed several light sources that were on when they should be off
[*] Fixed several mode clipping or z-fighting issues
[*] Fixed soft lock spot in Chapter 3 where the player can get stuck
[*] Fixed many Null References when using the Lift in Chapter 3
[*] Minor update to prop texture
[*] Fixed soft lock spot in Chapter 5 where the player can get stuck
[*] Update collision where the player can clip through models in various areas
[*] Re-added missing Lost Ones in Chapter 5 ending area
[/list]

While we were in there we did a few other adjustments and fixes that are super minor. It's been a good 6 years or so since we've done any updates to the game so it's been an interesting experience going back in time. Maybe we'll do it again sometime soon!

Thanks everyone

- Bendy Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.1.1
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We just pushed a quick hotfix to address 2 minor visual issues, as well as add in a new feature
[list]
[*] Fixed Chains holding the pallet in Chapter 2
[*] Fixed Chains holding the pallet in Chapter 4
[*] Added SKIP ability for Chapter 5 opening sequence
[/list]
[h3]SKIP[/h3]
In order to skip, you just need to press "Interact" twice to skip a sequence. So that would be "E" for example. This will help you get into the action sooner if you don't want to watch these sequences.


Thank you!

- Bendy Team

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!

We have been able to work on some much needed bug fixes as well as some minor adjustments throughout the game. While we were at it we decided to have some Halloween fun and include some spookiness to Bendy's universe. Ink Demon's Eve runs from October 23-31 every year.

[h3]Patch Notes for v1.5.1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Chapter 2 Flooded Stairs Lever to become active sooner
[*] Added ability to skip the JDS Logo on launch
[*] Added a "Toggle Run" option
[*] Slightly Increased weapon range and attack radius
[*] Significantly reduced the length of the Chapter 5 Harbor Battle
[*] Removed the Store Button from the main menu (you can go to [url=https://bendymerch.com/]bendymerch.com[/url] though!)
[*] Updated the credits with Co-Creator Mike Desjardins
[*] Fixed several null references from spamming in the background
[*] Added some spooky stuff for Halloween
[*] Added a Halloween dedicated achievement[/list]
[h3]With assistance from [b]chazaswag[/b], who helped locate issues in the code:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Sammy's name on his Audio Log
[*] Fixed Chapter 4 Audio Log achievement
[*] Fixed Chapter Select button from becoming disabled
[*] Fixed Save Glitch where no OnFileWriteEvent event was being cleared
[*] Fixed Volume settings not being applied at start
[*] Fixed Chapter 3 Ending Elevator Softlock
[*] Workaround Fix for Chapter 5 Weak Plank Softlock
[*] Added chazaswag to the credits
[/list]
Bendy and the Ink Machine no longer supports Linux, Mac, or Windows 32-bit. So this update will not take place on those platforms. However your game should still run as it was in v1.5, If you're having any trouble you can always revert back to v1.5 by right clicking the game in your Steam library, going to [b]Properties...[/b] and selecting the Betas tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28575515/0c2a426165695de474cbfdc78806f3111f479f79.png[/img]

Happy Halloween! Stay safe everyone!

- Bendy Team
